text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Biwa Hayahide wanted to go out
and train, so I accompanied them, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright, we've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The summit of the mountain. Just the right amount of snow has accumulated.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Listen carefully, Trainer.
I am—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to run alongside Santa's reindeer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I know exactly how you feel.
When I was first told about this,
I made the exact same face you're making right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The speed of Santa's reindeer?
Even assuming only the Northern Hemisphere, based on the number of children...
I'd deduce it's likely near the speed of light.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That much...!
Just what kind of training does one need to do
to become that fast...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
!? ...Y-You don't mean to say
you're trying to catch up to them, do you?
To a reindeer running at near-lightspeed...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Running together with Santas
is bound to be fun, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...And so, you see.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Don't you think Trainer looks like they're having fun, too?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When she looks at you with those eyes,
you just can't stop her... You know what I mean, right?
choice_data_list: ...Alright, let's catch up to the reindeer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
I'm counting on you...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the log cabin is fully decorated.
Let's see just how much Oguri-san can perform under the exact same conditions as Santa Claus—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I tried running a bit, but the snowy path
makes you lose your footing, so it's hard to run properly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
To be able to run so freely through that...
Reindeer must have incredibly strong legs and hips...
choice_data_list: In that case, you should train your lower body too.
In that case, you should train your lower body too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I have a good idea.
Please follow me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I built snowmen along the open mountain path. Please run while dodging them. Bracing yourself through the turns should strengthen your legs and hips.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Besides, if we crashed into it,
the snowman would probably get hurt.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... That was a harder workout
than I expected, but...
It wasn't impossible for me...!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still... does Santa's reindeer really pull
a sleigh on top of doing all this...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Then there is no reason for me to back down...!
As for the sled—Trainer, would you ride on it?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I think that's a great idea.
Please leave the support to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up riding in
the sled pulled by Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How is it, Trainer...?! Am I running properly...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running was so fast you could hardly believe
she was pulling a sled.
That must be just how serious she is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up a full round of training,
we clocked the times once again, and...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
How's the time?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...We did it! Training in the snow
really does pay off!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides............ hoo, hoo, hee, foo~~.
...Yes... this feeling, after all, is—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Next time, why don't we try
actually racing Santa's reindeer!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I finally caught up a little, so please,
let me test these legs of mine...!
choice_data_list: There's no need to rush into it.
There's no need to rush into it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I finally caught up a little, so please,
let me test these legs of mine...!
choice_data_list: There's no need to rush into it.
There's no need to rush into it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Come to think of it...
Where do all the Santas actually live in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...It's just one theory, but it is often said that they live in Finland."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Overseas, huh... That's pretty far.
Besides, racing overseas means
the conditions will be completely different, too...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, first comes Japan.
We've got to give it our all, Trainer...!"

And so, determined to compete with a reindeer one day,
Oguri Cap resolved to push forward even further.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is that so...?
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you build up your skills before meeting them?
Shouldn't you build up your skills before meeting them?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! Indeed, you are right!
Half-hearted skills would be an insult to the reindeer as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood... First, let us hone my abilities further.
We shall take on the challenge after that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're making steady progress,
so I'm sure you'll be fine, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
! Indeed...! If I keep this up,
the day I can run alongside reindeer won't be far off.
Ah... I can hardly wait!

Oguri Cap made that vow
with a radiant smile on her face.
